mapper.select: select u.user_id as userId, d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, d.parent_id as parentId, d.ancestors as ancestors, d.dept_type as deptType from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
